executiveSummary: Active OT targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs continues across multiple sectors (Water/Wastewater, Energy, Critical Manufacturing), with abuse of S7comm (TCP/102), weak protections, and AI-assisted scripts. Immediate hardening and segmentation are required. Security Advisory Exploitation of Siemens Simatic IOT2050 gateways (Node-RED enabled, pre-4.3.4.1) observed in the wild to deploy botnet payloads on devices bridging IT and OT. Patch or remove Node-RED exposure and reimage suspected hosts. View Article Coordinated manipulation of supermarket refrigeration controllers across Europe caused widespread food spoilage, underscoring risks from internet-exposed cold-chain OT and weak remote access governance. View Article Critical PHP RCE vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618/109619) are under active exploitation at Internet scale; compromise of public-facing sites at critical infrastructure operators increases IT-to-OT pivot risk. Patch now; apply WAF virtual patches and hunt for web shells. CISA Alert Supporting Report Edge-access exploitation remains elevated: actively exploited Ivanti Connect Secure VPN and NetScaler ADC/Gateway RCEs enable enterprise entry and potential lateral movement toward OT. Security Advisory Advisory Nation-state activity: joint advisories highlight China-nexus use of covert device networks and Russian operations via misconfigured routers-both threaten segmentation boundaries around industrial networks. Advisory Advisory

keyFindings.title: Direct OT risk is elevated by two concurrent vectors
keyFindings.summary: (1) active exploitation of industrial gateways/PLCs (Siemens IOT2050, S7 families) and (2) enterprise edge & web tier compromise (VPN, NetScaler, PHP), which provide credible pivot paths into control environments. Security Advisory View Article

keyFindings.title: Cold-chain sabotage across multiple EU countries confirms active OT manipulation
keyFindings.summary: Cold-chain sabotage across multiple EU countries confirms active OT manipulation of building/process systems; third-party remote access governance and de-exposure of controllers are immediate priorities. View Article

keyFindings.summary: Mass exploitation of PHP (KEV-listed) and continued WordPress Core KEV activity require emergency patching, WAF rules, and compromise assessment on DMZ assets used by utilities, municipalities, and healthcare. CISA Alert

keyFindings.title: Ransomware pressure persists
keyFindings.summary: Gunra RaaS leverages edge device exploits (e.g., Fortinet) and LOTL tooling; segmentation and immutable backups remain essential to protect critical services. CISA Advisory

keyFindings.summary: Enterprise identity and SD-WAN controllers remain attractive targets (PeopleSoft exploitation by ShinyHunters; VeloCloud Orchestrator SQLi in the wild), increasing risk to distributed industrial footprints. Supporting Report

relevance: - Direct device risk: Siemens S7 families (PUT/GET), IOT2050 gateways, and refrigeration/drive controllers expose pre-auth or weakly protected write paths enabling process manipulation or sustained DoS. - Boundary erosion: Actively exploited VPN/ADC gateways and PHP web tiers increase the likelihood of IT-to-OT pivots where segmentation, identity controls, and monitoring are weak. - Third-party access: Cold-chain disruptions and SD-WAN/Orchestrator exploitation highlight risks from contractor tooling and centralized management planes across distributed sites. - Nation-state posture: Covert device networks and router abuse complicate attribution and detection, necessitating egress controls, device hygiene, and OT-aware IDS coverage.

items: EPICS Base ≤7.0.10 - pre-auth DoS/memory corruption (upgrade 7.0.11). CISA ICS Advisory
Hitachi Energy TRO600 - localhost bypass & arbitrary file read; patch 9.2.2.1/≥9.1.2.0. ICS Advisory
Hitachi Energy CoreTec - auth cmd injection & IPsec LPE; upgrade CoreTec5 5.0.0. ICS Advisory
Subnet Solutions PowerSYSTEM Center - authz bypass & SQLi (adjacent network). ICS Advisory
PHP RCE (CVE-2026-109618/109619): actively exploited; patch immediately. CISA
NetScaler ADC/Gateway (CVE-2026-88771/88772): unauth RCE; active exploitation. JPCERT/CC
Ivanti Connect Secure VPN: RCE/priv-esc; active exploitation. CERT-FR
Zimbra ZCS 0-day: view-based XSS leading to account takeover & mass exfiltration. Joint Advisory

outlook72h: - Expect continued high-volume opportunistic exploitation of PHP RCE across public sites; prioritize emergency patching and WAF coverage on any PHP-based portals in DMZs. - Maintain heightened monitoring of VPN/ADC edges (Ivanti/NetScaler) for post-patch compromise indicators and session re-use attempts. - Increased scanning of TCP/102 and Internet-exposed Node-RED endpoints likely; tighten ACLs and remove direct exposure. - Cold-chain/retail OT: anticipate follow-on attempts against exposed refrigeration/BMS controllers; proactively lock down access and confirm manual fallback procedures.
